text: 国金证券首席策略官、副所长牟一凌接受券商中国记者采访时表示，9月中下旬以来，A股市场表现承压，外部不确定性加剧是本轮回调的核心扰动。当前核心蓝筹股的估值水平已经处于历史偏低水平，尤其成长类大盘蓝筹性价比凸显。
text_en: Mou Yiling, chief strategist and deputy director of Sinolink Securities, said in an interview with Securities Times' Brokerage China that since mid-to-late September, the A-share market has come under pressure, with heightened external uncertainty the core disturbance behind the pullback. Valuations of core blue-chip stocks are already at historically low levels, with the cost-effectiveness of large-cap growth blue chips particularly prominent.
